name: The missing king

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Slim identifies Varian Wrynn and implicates Hendel in the ship plan.
description: Slim gives up the name at the center of the search: the “diplomat” is Varian Wrynn, Stormwind’s missing king. Slim says Hendel was meant to board the king’s ship. This portrait is a record of the absent subject, not a claim that Varian stood at the Menethil inn. The trail now has a face and an intended accomplice, but no recovered king and no account of what became of the voyage.
